verdict.rationale: Source report states confirmed attack progressed through Credential Access and Collection; data access was confirmed.

summary: From 2026-07-17 23:09:23 to 23:09:24, source IP 185.220.101.34 performed password spraying against three accounts, accessed m.fischer@contoso.com through Microsoft Graph, and obtained a managed identity token through IMDS on webapp-vm-001. The report states data access was confirmed.

representationNotes.commentary: Source report provides ordered recommendations but does not assign urgency labels. Action priorities were normalized to immediate/next to fit schema and may not preserve author intent exactly.
representationNotes.suggestedVocabularyExtension: Allow source-ordered recommendations without forced priority enum.

representationNotes.commentary: Alert title states Tor Exit Node, but the report does not explicitly model Tor as a separate indicator or provide corroborating network evidence beyond the title.
representationNotes.suggestedVocabularyExtension: Allow alert-asserted infrastructure attributes with separate confidence from indicators.

representationNotes.commentary: Client application outlook-client-app-id is listed as an IOC but is not explicitly linked to a specific timeline event in the source.
representationNotes.suggestedVocabularyExtension: Support unlinked contextual indicators tied to incident scope.

representationNotes.commentary: m.fischer@contoso.com appears as a mailbox while timeline event references account name m.fischer in ROPC sign-in activity. Model normalizes this to a mailbox entity and preserves spray targeting through relationships.
representationNotes.suggestedVocabularyExtension: Allow paired user and mailbox representations for the same principal with alias linkage.

representationNotes.commentary: Source states the attack progressed through Credential Access and Collection and data access was confirmed. Schema impact categories do not include a generic confirmed attack progression concept, so this is retained in summary/verdict text.
representationNotes.suggestedVocabularyExtension: Add incident progression/asserted kill-chain outcome vocabulary.
